name: git-operations
title_zh: 让 Agent 安全操作 Git 的守则与避坑指南
tagline_zh: 重置工作区、rebase 翻车、误提交——这些坑 Agent 常踩。这份守则让它在动手前先想清楚，不把仓库搞乱。
tagline_en: Resets, rebase traps, bad commits—the usual agent mess. This rulebook makes it think before it touches your repo.
desc_en: Git safety and operational guidance for Scion agents. Covers working tree resets, rebase pitfalls, and general git behavior that agents should know regardless of workspace mode. For workspace-mode-specific git rules, see the git-sandbox skill.
why_zh: 不是命令速查，而是行为约束：明确何时该停、何时该问，把 Git 的破坏性操作变成可预期的流程。
why_en: Not a command cheat-sheet but a behavioral guardrail: it defines when to stop and ask, turning destructive Git ops into.
limit_zh: 只覆盖通用 Git 行为，不含工作区模式专属规则；需要配合 git-sandbox skill 使用。
limit_en: Covers only general Git behavior, not workspace-mode rules; requires git-sandbox skill for sandbox-specific constraints.
